title: 第3章 反杀章南获得储物袋第4章 黑市购买敛息术象甲功
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
陆成被林倾月抓住衣领，数秒间二人便来到屋内。
刚到屋内，林倾月玉手轻轻一挥，一道灵力结界将整个屋子彻底笼罩。
林倾月转过头，淡然地望着陆成，“等着我给你脱？”
我想看你脱……陆成自然不敢将内心癖好想法道出，风风火火地脱衣，转身便看到林倾月已经赤裸着身子躺在床上，美眸轻轻闭着。
陆成直接扑了上去。
……
四个时辰后，林倾月光着身子坐起来，双手结印，胸口双峰缓缓起伏，正在很有规律地吐纳灵气修炼。
陆成早已大汗淋漓，躺在一侧，目光在林倾月的身上反复横扫，最终定格在林倾月的玉颜上。
林倾月身为青玄宗宗主，修为和心境早已让她对任何事都能保持淡然，但被一个男子直勾勾地反复盯着身子，她多少还是极不习惯，尽管面前这个男子是她亲自挑选的炉鼎。
林倾月美眸睁开，缓缓站起身，手轻轻一挥，手中凭空出现一件长裙，穿在身上，然后盘膝坐下，继续修炼，数秒后她再也忍不住问道：“你一直看着我做什么？”
因为你实在太美了……陆成嘴角微微扬起：“宗主，你看我也突破炼气一层了，也没有个灵技可以修炼，不知宗主手里有没有我可以修炼的灵技功法？”
林倾月没有说话，她继续修炼着，直到太阳升起，临走时，她扔到床榻上一个册子，然后推门离开。
陆成将册子拿起，顿时笑了起来：“这次嫖资不错，竟然是引力术！”
陆成望着林倾月的背影，嘴角微微勾起。
炉鼎么？
弟子可是很贪心呢！
这次林倾月没有留下夺灵丹，显然是认为陆成已突破炼气一层，可以成为一个合格的炉鼎，供她双修。
陆成打开册子，上面详细地介绍了一种叫【引力术】的法术，它属于最基础的法术，只要达到炼气一层便可以修炼。
脑子里默记引力术的法诀，陆成怦然心动。
这引力术，便是驱使飞剑的前期基础仙术。

所谓引力术，其实说白了就是隔空控制物体。
若是灵活度高了，炼气二层，就可练习驱物术，待突破炼气三层后，便可以去灵宝峰，选取飞剑。
青玄宗毕竟是大周王朝内五百年的修仙宗门，宗门藏经阁内有大量的修仙法术，原则是每一个弟子都可以通过灵石去宗门内购买法术，大多数长辈则是劝慰弟子先修行引力术和选一把灵剑。
用引力术控制灵剑，前期容易掌握，无论是御剑飞行还是御剑杀人，对于炼气期的弟子都是最好的选择。
陆成默念引力术口诀，走到桌子跟前，对桌子上的水杯施展引力术。
水杯纹丝不动。
陆成没有放弃，继续用引力术控制着水杯，直到体内灵力彻底耗尽前，面前的水杯突然开始颤抖起来。
陆成脸上露出明灿笑容，他现在要尽快提升境界。
就在这时，屋外再度响起一道声音，今日的废丹已被送了过来，催促他尽快去处理废丹。
陆成来到院子外处理废丹。
接下来的五天，陆成早早将废丹处理完，练习引力术。
content_en:
Lu Cheng was grabbed by Lin Qingyue's collar, and within seconds the two of them arrived at the house.
As soon as she arrived at the house, Lin Qingyue waved her jade hand gently, and a spiritual barrier completely enveloped the entire house.
Lin Qingyue turned her head and looked at Lu Cheng indifferently, "Waiting for me to take off your clothes?"
I want to see you take off... Lu Cheng naturally didn't dare to express his inner fetish and thoughts, so he took off his clothes in a hurry. When he turned around, he saw Lin Qingyue lying naked on the bed, her beautiful eyes gently closed.
Lu Cheng pounced directly.
…
Four hours later, Lin Qingyue sat up naked, her hands formed a seal, her chest rose and fell slowly, and she was breathing in spiritual energy regularly to practice.
Lu Cheng was already sweating profusely, lying on one side, his eyes swept over Lin Qingyue's body repeatedly, and finally settled on Lin Qingyue's beautiful face.
As the leader of the Qingxuan Sect, Lin Qingyue's cultivation and state of mind have long allowed her to remain indifferent to everything, but she is still not used to having a man stare directly at her repeatedly, even though the man in front of her is the furnace she personally selected.
Lin Qingyue opened her beautiful eyes and stood up slowly. With a wave of her hand, a long dress appeared out of thin air and she put it on. Then she sat down cross-legged and continued to practice. After a few seconds, she couldn't help but ask: "What are you looking at me for?"
Because you are so beautiful... Lu Cheng raised the corner of his mouth slightly: "Sect Master, you see, I have also broken through the first level of Qi refining, and I don't have any spiritual skills to practice. I wonder if the Sect Master has any spiritual skills that I can practice?"
Lin Qingyue said nothing. She continued to practice until the sun rose. Before leaving, she threw a booklet on the bed, then opened the door and left.
Lu Cheng picked up the book and immediately laughed: "This time the money is good, it turns out to be gravity!"
Lu Cheng looked at Lin Qingyue's back and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
A furnace?
The disciple is very greedy!
This time, Lin Qingyue did not leave any spirit-seizing pills. Apparently she believed that Lu Cheng had broken through the first level of Qi refining and could become a qualified cauldron for her to practice dual cultivation.
Lu Cheng opened the booklet, which introduced in detail a spell called [Gravity]. It is the most basic spell and can be practiced as long as you reach the first level of Qi Refining.
Lu Cheng's heart skipped a beat as he memorized the gravity technique in his mind.
This gravity technique is the basic magic technique used to drive flying swords in the early stage.
The so-called gravity technique is actually to put it bluntly, it is to control objects from a distance.
If your flexibility is high, you can practice the object-dispelling technique at the second level of Qi Refining. After breaking through the third level of Qi Refining, you can go to Lingbao Peak and choose the flying sword.
After all, Qingxuan Sect was a sect that cultivated immortality for 500 years in the Zhou Dynasty. There were a large number of magic spells for cultivating immortals in the sect's scripture collection pavilion. The principle was that every disciple could go to the sect to buy spells through spiritual stones. Most of the elders advised the disciples to practice gravity and choose a spiritual sword first.
Using gravity to control the spirit sword is easy to master in the early stage. Whether it is flying with the sword or killing with the sword, it is the best choice for disciples in the Qi refining stage.
Lu Cheng recited the gravity spell silently, walked to the table, and cast the gravity spell on the water glass on the table.
The water glass didn't move at all.
Lu Cheng did not give up and continued to use gravity to control the water cup. Until the spiritual power in his body was completely exhausted, the water cup in front of him suddenly began to tremble.
A bright smile appeared on Lu Cheng's face. He now wanted to improve his level as soon as possible.
At this moment, a voice sounded outside the house again. Today's waste pills had been sent over, urging him to deal with them as soon as possible.
Lu Cheng came outside the yard to deal with the waste pills.
In the next five days, Lu Cheng finished processing the waste pills early and practiced the gravity technique.
